newsitem.title: USA: Unicom Corp Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Unicom Corp Q4 net rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: 1995 Q4 operation and maintenance expenses included an $88 million charge for voluntary employee separation plans, which reduced net income by $53 million or $0.25/shr.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: 1995 Q4 includes an extraordinary loss of $20 million, or $0.09/shr, for early redemption of $645 million of long-term debt.

1995 year results include $97 million charge for employee separation plans that reduced net income by $59 million, or $0.27/share, compared to a charge of $12 million in 1996, which reduced 1996 net income by $7 million, or $0.03/share.

A reduction in real estate taxes increased 1996 net income by $28 million, or $0.13/share, compared to the same previous year. An income tax refund increased 1996 net income by $26 million, or $0.12/share. 1996 net income was reduced by $20 million, or $0.09/share from increased depreciation charges on the company's nuclear generating units.
